summary.text: Chuck Cook is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 33B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
A U.S. Army veteran who works in government administration, he lives in Crofton with his wife and three children, according to his Ballotpedia profile and survey.

paragraphs.text: Cook's Ballotpedia profile lists Wicomico Senior High School, a bachelor's degree from Salisbury University in 2006, and service in the U.S. Army from 1999 to 2003.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in a single-income, working-class family.
Cook listed labor, the environment, public safety and health care as his policy interests.

He said he wants to make housing, food, energy, health care and transportation more affordable and accessible, and to protect green spaces and reduce nutrient and runoff pollution to the Chesapeake Bay.
